Let me implement the standard "mark pairs" fixpoint with a queue:

```python
def is_minimal(n, sigma, nxt, acc):
    # table[p][q] = distinguishable
    dist = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]
    q = deque()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            if acc[i] != acc[j]:
                dist[i][j] = dist[j][i] = True
                q.append((i,j))
    # reverse transitions
    rev = [[[] for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(sigma)]
    for s in range(n):
        for c in range(sigma):
            rev[c][nxt[s][c]].append(s)
    while q:
        i,j = q.popleft()
        for c in range(sigma):
            for p in rev[c][i]:
                for r in rev[c][j]:
                    if p != r and not dist[p][r]:
                        dist[p][r] = dist[r][p] = True
                        q.append((p,r))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            if not dist[i][j]:
                return False
    return True
```
